name: Del Monte Fruit Cocktail in 100% Juice or Water
whyItWorks: A classic hospital soft-diet item: diced peeled peaches, pears, seedless grapes, and cherry halves packed in light juice. Every fruit piece is skinless, seedless, and cooked until soft.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Drain packing juice. Eat with a spoon for easy, no-effort fruit calories.
watchOuts: Verify light juice or water pack rather than heavy corn syrup.
